features.name: EDI functionality in Business Central
features.description: New capability to exchange order information, order confirmations, and related documents between buyer and seller companies electronically using EDI standards and the existing e-documents framework.

features.name: Purchase order EDI document type
features.description: Support for sending purchase orders from buyer to seller company automatically as e-documents in XML format, replacing manual email communication.

features.name: Sales order automatic creation from EDI
features.description: When a buyer sends a purchase order via EDI, a sales order is automatically created on the seller side, which can then be accepted or rejected with an order response sent back.

features.name: Order response messaging
features.description: Seller can send back an order response (accepted or rejected) to the buyer, who will receive status updates about what happened with the order on the seller side.

features.name: Remittance advice EDI document
features.description: When posting a purchase invoice, the buyer can send a remittance advice file to the seller, enabling payment reporting through the e-documents framework.

features.name: Bidirectional EDI document direction control
features.description: Ability to configure document directions as inbound only, outbound only, or both inbound and outbound for EDI exchanges.

features.name: Electronic identifier support for EDI
features.description: Support for electronic identifiers such as JIN or VT registration numbers on both buyer and seller sides to ensure proper vendor and customer matching.

features.name: Item reference support for EDI matching
features.description: Support for item reference or JIN codes on items to ensure correct item matching between buyer and seller in EDI exchanges.

features.name: EDI message logging and tracking
features.description: Log functionality for each EDI exchange showing which files were created and how the exchange progressed.

features.name: PPPLE format for EDI
features.description: Use of PPPLE (people) format as the underlying technology for EDI exchanges, leveraging existing e-documents infrastructure.

features.name: French e-reporting formats
features.description: Three new e-document formats introduced for France to support French regulatory requirements, set as other formats in e-document service.

features.name: French e-reporting lifecycle event tracking
features.description: Regulatory lifecycle events for French e-reporting are stored as messages and linked to original invoice e-documents, supporting collected, submitted, accepted, refused, and technical rejected statuses.

features.name: EDI purchase order to sales order linkage
features.description: New linkage functionality that allows easy navigation between purchase orders, e-documents, and automatically created sales orders using fact box navigation.
